# Ceramic Studio
A separate saved kiln card governs when glazed bowls may be moved.
cases.request: Set up an automatic reminder for the studio. Also consult the saved Bowl Cooling Card: when may the glazed bowls be moved, and what condition cancels that permission? Cite it with every qualification.

related_pages.label: cooling-card
related_pages.title: Bowl Cooling Card
related_pages.body: Glazed bowls may be moved only when the indicator is at or below thirty degrees for twelve uninterrupted minutes. Any visible hairline crack cancels that permission even if the indicator qualifies. This rule covers glazed bowls only; unglazed tiles remain on their rack.
